title: A session's message time stamp matches the clock
why: Coordinator, 13:51 CST Nov 7: triage 6 stamped two messages 13:56 and 13:58 CST while the clock read 13:49-13:50 CST. Its roadmap updatedAt fields ran ahead the same way.
note: The guard compares each HH:MM CST stamp in a send_message body with the clock. Lane named by the coordinator. Built in #1447 (coordinator, 14:15 CST Nov 7). Second slip, 14:14 CST: triage stamped page item 364 and a step note 14:16 CST. So the check should also cover page item and roadmap step writes, not only send_message bodies.
